body:
🚀 [Mortium optimised]
Experience the perfect balance between stunning aesthetics and blazing-fast performance. This modpack is carefully crafted to modernize your Minecraft experience without losing the classic Vanilla feel.

✨ Key Features
🚀 Maximum Optimization: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and various performance tweaks to squeeze every frame out of your hardware.

🌈 Next-Gen Visuals: Built-in Iris Shaders support allows you to run your favorite shaders with much better stability than Optifine.

🖼️ Enhanced Graphics: Includes Connected Textures (Continuity), smoother animations, and improved fog/lighting effects.

🛠️ Lightweight & Stable: No "bloatware" mods. Every mod is selected to ensure your game stays crash-free and smooth.

📦 Core Mod Highlights
Sodium: The gold standard for engine optimization and FPS boosting.

Iris: Modern shader support for beautiful lighting and shadows.

Lithium: Enhances game logic and server-side performance.

Continuity & Indium: Enables connected glass and complex block rendering.

Reese's Sodium Options: Provides a cleaner and more detailed video settings menu.

🛠️ System requirements 
CPU: intel core i5 2th gen+
RAM: We recommend allocating at least 6GB of RAM for a smooth experience.
Graphics:1gb+ graphics card supports opengl
OS:Windows 10+
